body:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: high rate of JWT verification failures in prod (PD-12345). Triggered at 02:05 UTC.

pagerduty: Notifying primary on-call Miguel Ramos (backend-oncall). Severity: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345

Miguel Ramos: acked. I'm looking.

Miguel Ramos: quick glance at gateway logs — 401 spikes, error says "no matching KID" on validation.

Priya Shah: auth-oncall here, taking over investigating token validation path. What do you see, Miguel?

Miguel Ramos: lots of requests to /oauth/verify failing, backend returns 500s and 401s. JWKS fetch looks odd.

Miguel Ramos: sample from verifier logs: ```ERROR verifier.go:132 - token validation failed: no matching KID: kid=Zk9aT3
2026-03-14T02:03:12Z request_id=xyz status=401 path=/api/v1/session
```

Priya Shah: running curl against jwks endpoint to check keys: `curl -s https://auth.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys | length'` -> returns 0.

Raj Patel: SRE chime in — anything recent on the signing-key-rotation job? I see a cron run ~01:58 UTC.

Miguel Ramos: yeah we had an automated rotation job rolled out to staging and prod last hour. Might be a bad rotation push.

Elena Torres: PM: We're already getting customer reports. Need quick triage and communication plan.

Sam Nguyen: Support: ticket #9876 raised by acme-corp; they report users can't log in since ~02:00 UTC. Marking as high severity.

Priya Shah: plan: 1) temporarily revert rotation flag 2) upload cached jwks (from last known-good) to the JWKS store 3) roll verifier pods 20%->100% 4) monitor error rate.

Miguel Ramos: executing step 1 now — toggling feature flag. Command: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MGMT_TOKEN' https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"auth.rotate_keys","value":false}'```

Miguel Ramos: flag toggled :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation timer set — will escalate to Eng Lead in 5m if not acknowledged.

Priya Shah: uploading cached jwks to storage bucket and triggering sync to auth-service.

Priya Shah: pushed jwks dump (cached-20260314.json) to s3://auth-jwks/fallback/ and triggered sync hook.

Priya Shah: initiating rolling restart of verifier deployment (canary 20%).

```bash
kubectl rollout restart deployment/verifier -n prod --selector=canary=true
kubectl rollout status deployment/verifier -n prod --watch
```

Priya Shah: canary verifiers picked up keys and started validating tokens. Error rate on gateway dropped from 7.2% -> 1.1% in 2 minutes.

Miguel Ramos: promoting rollout to 100%.

Priya Shah: full rollout complete. Post-rollout logs: token validation ok. Example: ```INFO verifier.go:98 - validated token kid=Ab3Xy status=200```

Nina Lopez: Customer Success: reached out to acme-corp and they confirm logins are working now.

Elena Torres: good — please prepare a short customer-facing note for affected tenants and a timeline.

Raj Patel: monitoring metrics and traces for 30m. I'll own the watch. Miguel — if you need a postmortem author, assign to me.

Miguel Ramos: handing off monitoring and follow-ups to Raj. I'm off-call.

Raj Patel: ack handoff. I'll keep alerts open and collect logs for the postmortem.

Priya Shah: immediate mitigation complete. Root cause appears to be malformed JWKS payload post-rotation (empty keys array). Follow-ups: add preflight validation for JWKS length on rotation, add automated fallback if keys empty, and block rotation if healthcheck fails.

incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 marked mitigated by Priya Shah. Incident ticket created INC-8942.

Elena Torres: noted. We'll schedule a postmortem with action items (preflight checks, alert tuning, runbook updates). Thanks all. :clap:

Sam Nguyen: updating support ticket and notifying affected customers.

Priya Shah: logging steps and artifact links in the incident ticket.

Raj Patel: closing slack thread after 30m of stable metrics.

incident-bot: Monitoring window started — will auto-close if no regression in 30m.
_meta: generated_for_dataset: unique slack incident thread about JWT/JWKS rotation failure, includes PagerDuty and on-call coordination
